entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Manuel Francisco Javier Espinosa y Espinosa was President of Ecuador, from 20 January 1868 to 19 January 1869. He was overthrown in a 1869 military coup carried out by Gabriel García Moreno. Gabriel García Moreno sought to prevent Juan Javier Espinosa from holding free elections.
